scope: Theorem 2.2 (Finite-type positive monoids) of the manuscript “Harmonic heights and the Artin K(pi,1) conjecture” (preprints/Harmonic-heights-and-the-Artin-K-pi-1-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 254 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. statement: Suppose that T is spherical, and let A+ T be its positive Artin monoid. Then the following statements hold. (i) The natural map A+ T → AT is injective. In particular, A+ T is cancellative on both sides. (ii) Every element of AT can be written both as ab−1 and as c−1d, with a, b, c, d ∈ A+ T . (iii) Any two elements of A+ T have a greatest common right divisor, and also a greatest common left divisor. (iv) If wT is the longest element of WT , then ∆T = ι(wT ) is the finite-type fundamental element. Its left divisors and its right divisors coincide and are exactly the elements ι(w), w ∈ WT .
